# goslop text fixture — records failure into result.error (logxide FP)
lang: python
file: CWE-396-batch3-result-error-safe.py
---
def run_scenario(result, fn):
    try:
        fn()
        result.ok = True
    except Exception as e:
        result.ok = False
        result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
